title: Bayesian efficient coding as a theory of perception: progress, controversies, and prospects
title_zh: 贝叶斯高效编码作为感知理论：进展、争议与前景
abstract: Bayesian efficient coding unifies two foundational theories of sensory processing: efficient coding and Bayesian inference. Central to this account is the idea that natural environmental statistics shape both how sensory information is encoded and how it is perceptually interpreted. By unifying these principles, the framework accounts for counterintuitive perceptual biases and establishes lawful relationships between environmental statistics, bias, and discrimination thresholds. In this article, we review behavioural and neural evidence for this theory in perception and cognition, as well as how short- and long-term adaptation to the environment may be expressed within the framework. We further review theoretical developments that extend the original framework, focusing on how response biases can be decomposed into encoding- and decoding-related components. A decade after its introduction, Bayesian efficient coding continues to evolve as a powerful theory, with recent extensions addressing early limitations and opening new directions for investigating perception and cognition.
abstract_zh: 贝叶斯高效编码统一了感觉处理的两大基础理论：高效编码与贝叶斯推断。该理论的核心在于自然环境统计特征共同塑造了感觉信息的编码方式及其知觉解释方式。通过统一这两项原则，该框架可解释反直觉的知觉偏差，并建立环境统计、偏差与辨别阈值之间的规律性关系。本文回顾了知觉与认知领域对该理论的行为和神经证据，以及环境短期与长期适应如何在框架内表达。我们进一步综述了扩展原始框架的理论发展，重点讨论反应偏差如何分解为编码相关与解码相关成分。该理论问世十年后仍在持续演进，近年来的扩展正在修正早期局限，并开辟了研究感知与认知的新方向。
